scientific_integrity: Distributional, moment and almost-sure statements analytically proved; numerical checks are illustrative, not exhaustive proofs. Original source algorithm and classical chi-square ratio identities acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Independent isotropic Gaussian observation errors, prescribed deterministic vanishing true residuals, and one-step exact-direction consequence only. No long-run stochastic optimization claim.
title: Gaussian noise-floor laws for geometric residual-ratio step selection
